Hi Marissa and Camila,

Great to meet both of you earlier — thanks for walking through Redwood's inference capabilities. Quick recap from our side and a couple of suggested next steps so we can get a technical deep dive on the calendar: 

Recap:
- CloudBridge is evaluating marketplace integration for our managed AI offerings; primary goals: predictable latency, support for private deployments (VPC), and strong observability for SRE teams.
- Initial scope: 3 use cases (chat assistant, vector search for knowledge bases, and reranking pipeline).
- Primary success criteria: <20% cost reduction per token compared to current infra, 99.9% uptime on critical routes, and straightforward key management (Customer KMS).

Suggested next steps:
1) Technical deep dive/demo with Redwood engineering to validate architecture and runthrough of the Dedicated and Private options. Expect 60–75 minutes.
2) Share architecture diagram and any pre-reqs for the session (test data, sample traffic).

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 25 May, 10:00–11:15
- Wed 26 May, 14:00–15:15
- Fri 28 May, 09:00–10:15

If none of these work, happy to use a Calendly link. I've attached a short suggested agenda.

Attaching: CloudBridge-Partner-Agenda.pdf (see stub)

Thanks,
Ethan Miller
Partner Solutions
